quotes.text: Can you discuss why the need for some of those higher standards in, you know, a higher standard of AI use framework in situations like that, and what some of the pitfalls are of not providing a higher standard for AI use in government than the private industry?
Do you believe that AI systems need independent oversight to ensure patients are not denied medically necessary care?

It's scary for a lot of lawmakers. I've been in a lot of briefings where my colleagues can't really wrap their heads around the broad implications of what AI can do. Some people say, just (put) a moratorium on all of it. That isn't really going to work. [...] I don't know what the bill is yet. There are a lot of different ideas. A lot of things are moving forward this Congress, but it's not going to be just one policy.
